question_types: net change after rise and fall

question_types: savings from income and expense ratios

subtopics.name: Complementary angles
question_types: sin A = cos B find angle

question_types: max of a sin + b cos

subtopics.name: Mean, median & mode
question_types: mean and mode from frequency graph

entries.name: Divisibility rules (2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9)
entries.statement: 2/5/10: last digit;\ 4: last two digits;\ 8: last three digits;\ 3/9: digit sum;\ \text{largest } n\text{-digit multiple of } d=(10^n-1)-((10^n-1)\bmod d)

entries.name: Divisibility by 11
entries.statement: 11\mid N \iff (\text{sum of odd-place digits}) - (\text{sum of even-place digits}) \equiv 0 \pmod{11}

entries.name: Divisibility by composite numbers
entries.statement: \text{If } n=ab,\ \gcd(a,b)=1:\ n\mid N \iff a\mid N \text{ and } b\mid N\ (6=2\cdot3,\ 36=4\cdot9,\ 40=8\cdot5)

entries.name: Divisibility of a^n - b^n
entries.statement: (a-b)\mid a^n-b^n \ \forall n;\ (a+b)\mid a^n-b^n \text{ for even } n;\ (a+b)\mid a^n+b^n \text{ for odd } n

entries.name: Remainder cycles of powers
entries.statement: a^n \bmod m \text{ repeats with a cycle; reduce } n \text{ modulo the cycle length}

entries.name: Remainder rules (substitution, divisor factor)
entries.statement: (a\cdot b)\bmod m=(a\bmod m)(b\bmod m)\bmod m;\ N\equiv r \pmod D,\ d\mid D \Rightarrow N\equiv r \pmod d

entries.name: Sums of first n naturals, squares, cubes
Fraction and decimal arithmetic
entries.statement: \frac ab \pm \frac cd=\frac{ad\pm bc}{bd};\ \text{convert mixed numbers and decimals to fractions before combining}

entries.name: Percent of a quantity
entries.statement: x\%\text{ of } N=\frac{x}{100}N;\ x\%\text{ of } y\%\text{ of } N=\frac{xy}{10^4}N;\ \text{share}\%=\frac{\text{part}}{\text{whole}}\times100

entries.name: A is r% more than B, so B is ?% less than A
entries.statement: \text{If } A=B(1+\tfrac r{100}) \text{ then } B \text{ is } \frac{r}{100+r}\times100\%\text{ less than } A

entries.name: Income = expenditure + savings
entries.statement: I=E+S;\ \Delta S=\Delta I-\Delta E\ (\text{in absolute terms})

entries.name: Price x consumption = expenditure
entries.statement: \text{To keep expenditure fixed after a } r\%\text{ price rise, cut consumption by } \frac{r}{100+r}\times100\%

entries.name: Dividing a quantity in a ratio
Direct, inverse and joint variation
entries.statement: y\propto x \Rightarrow y=kx;\ y\propto \tfrac1x \Rightarrow xy=k;\ y\propto \tfrac{x}{z} \Rightarrow y=k\tfrac{x}{z}

entries.name: Income and expenditure in ratios
entries.statement: I_1:I_2=a:b,\ E_1:E_2=c:d \Rightarrow S_i=I_i-E_i;\ \text{set } I_1=ax, I_2=bx, E_1=cy, E_2=dy

entries.name: Average of an AP / consecutive numbers
Profit / loss percent and CP from SP
Gain as a fraction of SP
Overall gain on parts sold at different rates
entries.statement: \text{overall }\%=\frac{\Sigma CP_i\,p_i}{\Sigma CP_i};\ \text{target SP of rest}=\text{target total}-\text{SP already realised}

entries.name: Successive discounts / gains
entries.statement: \text{single equivalent of } d_1,d_2=d_1+d_2-\frac{d_1d_2}{100};\ \text{successive gains } a,b: a+b+\frac{ab}{100}

entries.name: Simple interest
entries.statement: SI=\frac{PRT}{100};\ A=P\left(1+\frac{RT}{100}\right);\ \text{equal interest on split: } P_1R_1T_1=P_2R_2T_2

entries.name: Instalments and reducing principal
entries.statement: \text{interest each period on outstanding principal; equal instalment } x:\ \Sigma x\left(1+\tfrac{R t_k}{100}\right)=A

entries.name: CI - SI for 2 and 3 years
entries.statement: 2\text{ yr}: P\left(\frac R{100}\right)^2;\ 3\text{ yr}: P\left(\frac R{100}\right)^2\left(3+\frac R{100}\right)

entries.name: Total work as LCM; efficiency ratio
Joining, leaving and alternating
entries.statement: \Sigma(\text{rate}_i\times\text{time worked}_i)=1;\ \text{alternating: work per cycle}=\Sigma\text{rates, then finish the remainder}

entries.name: Meeting on a circular track
entries.statement: t_{\text{first meet}}=\frac{L}{|v_1\mp v_2|}\ (- \text{ same direction},\ + \text{ opposite});\ \text{at start: } \mathrm{LCM}\left(\tfrac L{v_1},\tfrac L{v_2}\right)

entries.name: Simultaneous linear equations
entries.statement: \text{eliminate or substitute; } x=\frac{c_1b_2-c_2b_1}{a_1b_2-a_2b_1};\ \text{cyclic 3-variable systems: add all equations first}

entries.name: Age ratios at two points in time
entries.statement: \frac{a-t}{b-t}=\frac pq \text{ with } a=kx,\ b=lx;\ \text{the age difference never changes}

entries.name: Exterior angle theorem
entries.statement: \text{exterior angle}=\text{sum of the two interior opposite angles}

entries.name: Isosceles triangle properties
entries.statement: AB=AC \Rightarrow \angle B=\angle C;\ \text{altitude from } A \text{ bisects } BC \text{ and } \angle A

entries.name: Equilateral triangle properties
entries.statement: h=\frac{\sqrt3}2a;\ R=\frac a{\sqrt3},\ r=\frac a{2\sqrt3};\ \text{a chord equal to the radius subtends } 60^\circ

entries.name: Midpoint theorem and BPT
entries.statement: DE\parallel BC \Rightarrow \frac{AD}{DB}=\frac{AE}{EC};\ \text{midpoint join}\parallel\text{third side}=\tfrac12\text{ of it}

entries.name: Congruence criteria and CPCT
entries.statement: SSS,\ SAS,\ ASA,\ AAS,\ RHS \Rightarrow \text{corresponding parts are equal (CPCT)};\ SSA, AAA \text{ are not criteria}

entries.name: Circle basics
entries.statement: \text{one circle through 3 non-collinear points; diameter is the longest chord; equal chords} \iff \text{equal arcs}

entries.name: Perpendicular from centre bisects a chord
entries.statement: \left(\frac{\text{chord}}2\right)^2+d^2=r^2;\ \text{common chord} \perp \text{line of centres and bisected by it}

entries.name: Angle at centre = twice angle at circumference
Angle in a semicircle
entries.statement: \text{angle in a semicircle}=90^\circ;\ \text{so a right triangle's circumradius}=\frac{\text{hypotenuse}}2

entries.name: Cyclic quadrilateral
entries.statement: \angle A+\angle C=\angle B+\angle D=180^\circ;\ \text{exterior angle}=\text{interior opposite angle}

entries.name: Tangent perpendicular to radius
entries.statement: OT\perp PT;\ \text{angle between two tangents from } P=180^\circ-\angle AOB

entries.name: Length of tangent from an external point
entries.statement: PT=\sqrt{d^2-r^2};\ \text{the two tangents from } P \text{ are equal}

entries.name: Alternate segment theorem
entries.statement: \text{angle between tangent and chord}=\text{inscribed angle in the alternate segment}

entries.name: Angle between secants / tangent and secant
Diagonals of special quadrilaterals
entries.statement: \text{parallelogram: bisect each other; rhombus/kite: perpendicular; rhombus } d_1^2+d_2^2=4a^2

entries.name: Cylinder volume and surface area
entries.statement: V=\pi r^2h;\ CSA=2\pi rh;\ TSA=2\pi r(r+h)

entries.name: Cone volume and surface area
entries.statement: l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2};\ V=\tfrac13\pi r^2h;\ CSA=\pi rl;\ TSA=\pi r(r+l)

entries.name: Cube and cuboid volume and surface area
Sphere and hemisphere
entries.statement: \text{sphere } V=\tfrac43\pi r^3,\ S=4\pi r^2;\ \text{hemisphere } V=\tfrac23\pi r^3,\ TSA=3\pi r^2

entries.name: sec + tan and cosec + cot conjugates
Squares and fourth powers of sin and cos
Divide through by cos to get tan
Compound angle and product-to-sum
entries.statement: \sin(A\pm B)=\sin A\cos B\pm\cos A\sin B;\ \tan(A+B)=\frac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A\tan B};\ 2\sin A\sin B=\cos(A-B)-\cos(A+B)

entries.name: Solving trig equations
entries.statement: \text{Convert to one ratio (e.g. } \cos^2=1-\sin^2), \text{ solve the resulting quadratic, keep } 0^\circ\le\theta\le90^\circ

entries.name: Range of a sin + b cos
Heights and distances
entries.statement: h=d\tan\theta \text{ (angle of elevation } \theta \text{ at horizontal distance } d)

entries.name: Read values and totals
entries.statement: \text{Read the needed cells/bars, add row or column totals, compare or rank}

entries.name: Averages from a chart
entries.statement: \text{average}=\frac{\text{sum of selected values}}{\text{count}};\ \text{compare averages via totals when counts are equal}

entries.name: Percentages and percent change from a chart
Derived quantities from given relations
entries.statement: \text{Combine table values with a stated relation (e.g. income}=\text{expenditure}\times(1+p)) \text{ to find the unknown}

entries.name: Median
entries.statement: \text{sorted data: middle value } \left(\tfrac{n+1}2\right)^{\text{th}};\ \text{even } n: \text{ mean of the two middle values}
